answer: Each new agent must lock a karst deposit equal to two epochs of expected attestation rewards, escrowed until the following close. It also publishes one unique identity thread: a hash of its long-lived key plus a single-use nonce that peers gossip into a public index and refuse to accept twice. At each settlement tide, attestors replay that index; if two answers collapse onto the same key or funding source, they slash the deposit and withhold attestations. A sybil farm then pays a full two-epoch stake per clone and loses it on any collision.
